title: TE Dae'Quan Wright waiting to hear if he can return to NFL after flirtation with LSU

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: TE Dae'Quan Wright waiting to hear if he can return to NFL after flirtation with LSU
sources.description: Tight end Dae'Quan Wright's bid to return to college football came to an end on Tuesday when LSU filled out their roster with other players amid threats from the SEC to pursue expelling the school from the conference due to their desire to add players who spent time in the NFL this summer.
